Package com.mimecast.robin.config.server

Class BotRetryConfig

java.lang.Object
com.mimecast.robin.config.ConfigFoundation
com.mimecast.robin.config.BasicConfig
com.mimecast.robin.config.server.BotRetryConfig
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class BotRetryConfig extends BasicConfig
Retry configuration for report bot endpoint delivery.

Report bots (dmarc, tlsrpt and forensic) keep a report on disk when its endpoint is unavailable and send it again later. The backoff uses the same geometric progression as the relay queue (see RetryScheduler), with defaults sized for an endpoint restart or a short outage rather than remote mail delivery.

Read from the optional retry object next to the bots list in bots.json5.

  • Field Details

    • DEFAULT_TOTAL_RETRIES

      public static final long DEFAULT_TOTAL_RETRIES
      Default total number of retries.

      With the other defaults the waits reach the 30 minute cap by the sixth retry, so 52 retries last about 24 hours and end close to DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_SECONDS.
